questions.prompt: In `ps -p $$ -o comm=`, what does `$$` expand to?

options.a: the exit code of the last command
options.b: the PID of the shell you are running
options.c: the number of arguments the shell was given

questions.prompt: You run shellcheck on a script; it prints nothing and exits 0. In one word, what is the script's status?
A script pastes fine into your bash terminal but dies when a container runs it with /bin/sh. Likeliest reason?

options.a: /bin/sh on Debian/Ubuntu is dash — bash-only syntax doesn't exist there
options.b: /bin/sh refuses files without the execute bit
